description: This file contains serialization utility functions for string conversions, hex encoding/decoding, base64 encoding, and Unicode code point conversions, primarily used within the Thunder::Core namespace.

methods.name: ToString
methods.description: Converts wide character string to std::string or vice versa, with support for length-based conversion.

methods.name: ToHexString
methods.description: Encodes byte arrays into hexadecimal string representation, with optional delimiter.

methods.name: FromHexString
methods.description: Decodes hexadecimal string into byte array, supporting optional delimiters.

methods.name: ToString
methods.description: Encodes byte array into base64 string, with optional padding.

methods.name: FromString
methods.description: Decodes base64 string into byte array, supporting ignore list characters.

methods.name: CodePointToUTF16
methods.description: Converts a Unicode code point to UTF-16 surrogate pair.

methods.name: UTF16ToCodePoint
methods.description: Converts UTF-16 surrogate pair to a Unicode code point.

methods.name: ToCodePoint
methods.description: Decodes a UTF-8 sequence to a Unicode code point.

methods.name: FromCodePoint
methods.description: Encodes a Unicode code point into UTF-8 sequence.

methods.name: ToQuotedString
methods.description: Escapes internal quotes in a string and wraps the string with specified quote character.
